The '''2022–23 Super League Greece''', known as '''Stoiximan Super League''' for sponsorship reasons, was the 87th season of the [[Super League Greece]], the top Greek professional league for association football clubs, since its establishment in 1959. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] were the defending champions. As the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]] was started on 21 November, the last round before stoppage was held on 13 November. The league was resumed games on 21 December.

Fourteen teams competed in the league – the top twelve teams from the previous season, the play-off winner and one team promoted from [[Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]]. [[Levadiakos F.C.|Levadiakos]] played in the Super League for the first time since the [[2018–19 Super League Greece|2018–19]] season. [[Apollon Smyrnis F.C.|Apollon Smyrnis]] were relegated to [[2022–23 Super League Greece 2]], ending their two-year stay in the top flight.

| match_ATR_AEK_note = Originally scheduled to be played on 5 February 2023, the match Atromitos – AEK Athens did not start. The referee, after an appeal from AEK, counted that the crossbars were below the designated limits. The people from Atromitos attempted to fix the issue, but one of the crossbars remained below the designated limits, therefore the match did not start.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/podosfairo/superleague1/atromitos-aek-anaboli-sto-paixnidi/4356379|title=Οριστική αναβολή στο Ατρόμητος-ΑΕΚ!|website=sport-fm.gr|date=5 February 2023|location=Online|lang=el}}</ref> On 14 February 2023, the court stated that the match will be conducted,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/podosfairo/superleague1/apofasi-gia-dieksagwgi-tou-atromitos-aek/4358403|title=Απόφαση για διεξαγωγή του Ατρόμητος-ΑΕΚ! Απαλλάχθηκαν οι γηπεδούχοι|website=sport-fm.gr|date=14 February 2023|location=Online|lang=el}}</ref> while AEK decided to appeal the decision.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/podosfairo/superleague1/aek-kanei-efesi-gia-tin-apofasi-tou-agwna-me-atromito/4358463|title=Κάνει έφεση η ΑΕΚ: "Φτάνει πια με τις παρεμβάσεις"!|website=sport-fm.gr|date=14 February 2023|location=Online|lang=el}}</ref> On 1 March 2023, the appeal was rejected.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/podosfairo/superleague1/aporrifthike-i-efesi-tis-aek-ginetai-to-mats-me-atromito/4361667|title=Απορρίφθηκε η έφεση της ΑΕΚ - Γίνεται το ματς με τον Ατρόμητο|date=1 March 2023|website=sport-fm.gr|location=Online|lang=el}}</ref> The match was conducted on 8 March 2023 and ended 0–1 in favour of AEK. On 10 March 2023, after their victory, AEK announced their intention to appeal to [[Court of Arbitration for Sport]] (CAS) to overturn the initial verdict which declared Atromitos innocent for the lowered crossbars.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/podosfairo/superleague1/aek-paei-sto-CAS-gia-tin-upothesi-me-atromito/4363919|title=AEK goes to CAS for the Atromitos case|website=sport-fm.gr|date=10 March 2023|lang=el}}</ref>
